validation_note: Official/public institutional sources only; analogies are lessons, not diagnoses.

cases.name: Lake Chapala
cases.observed_pattern: NASA documents lower lake levels alongside diminished Lerma River inflow from dams, heavy irrigation use and regional drought, with Guadalajara depending on the lake for water.
cases.management_lesson: Separate climate-driven inflow deficits from upstream storage and consumptive withdrawals before attributing lake decline.

provenance.title: Lake Chapala, Mexico
provenance.supports: Lake-level decline is linked to diminished Lerma inflow from dams, irrigation demand and drought; the lake is a major Guadalajara water source.

cases.name: Lake Neusiedl / Fertő
cases.observed_pattern: NASA documents a lake only about two metres deep that has expanded greatly in wet periods and dried completely during several historical intervals.
cases.management_lesson: Use long historical baselines in very shallow lakes so natural climate-driven variability is not mistaken for a new local hydraulic failure.

provenance.title: Lake Neusiedl and Lake Ferto
provenance.supports: The very shallow lake has experienced large weather-driven extent changes and several complete historical dry periods.

cases.name: Sea of Galilee / Lake Kinneret
cases.observed_pattern: NASA reports a decades-long level decline that nearly reached a record low in 2018, with research pointing strongly to agricultural expansion and diversions; wet winters later produced a substantial rebound.
cases.management_lesson: Compare withdrawals and irrigated-area change against rainfall and recovery after wet years to distinguish human and climatic controls.

provenance.title: Sea of Galilee
provenance.supports: NASA describes the decline, salinity risk, agricultural/diversion explanation and rebound after two wet winters.

cases.name: Lake Fitri
cases.observed_pattern: NASA maps ancient shorelines and repeated dry phases in a terminal Sahara lake whose level responds directly to the balance between Wadi Batha inflow and evaporation.
cases.management_lesson: Map basin elevation, former shorelines, feeder channels and evaporation together before assuming that a smaller water surface means a blocked local outlet.

provenance.title: Lake Fitri, Chad
provenance.supports: The terminal lake is controlled by river inflow versus evaporation; ancient beaches and dunes record repeated larger and drier phases.

cases.name: Mar Chiquita / Mar de Ansenuza
cases.observed_pattern: NASA reports water levels consistently below 1980s-1990s levels and notes rainfall-drought cycles plus irrigation withdrawals from a key tributary, while exposed saline mud flats generate dust.
cases.management_lesson: Treat exposed sediment and dust as downstream indicators of the same water-balance problem, and monitor the tributary where withdrawals occur.

provenance.title: Dust and Salt in South America
provenance.supports: Lower Mar Chiquita levels are associated with drought/rainfall cycles and irrigation withdrawals; exposed flats produce saline dust.

cases.name: Lake Maharlu
cases.observed_pattern: NASA describes a closed desert lake where annual evaporation exceeds rainfall, the bed is often dry, salts accumulate, and runoff can also carry pollution into the basin.
cases.management_lesson: In closed basins, distinguish water-quantity loss from concentration effects: declining volume can amplify salinity and contaminant signals even without a new pollutant source.

provenance.title: Red on White: Lake Maharlu
provenance.supports: Evaporation exceeds rainfall, the lake is often dry, salts accumulate in the closed basin, and upstream runoff can carry chemical pollution.

cases.name: Lake Kariba
cases.observed_pattern: NASA documents a record-low reservoir period in late 2022 after severe drought limited recharge while demand remained high, constraining hydropower generation.
cases.management_lesson: Track storage against operational thresholds and inflow forecasts; visible shoreline retreat alone does not show how close a managed reservoir is to functional failure.

provenance.title: Low Water Level on Lake Kariba
provenance.supports: Severe drought limited recharge while demand was high; record-low water constrained electricity production.

cases.name: Toshka Lakes
cases.observed_pattern: NASA documents lakes created by diverted Lake Nasser water whose surface area later fell by roughly 80 percent from 2002 to 2012, leaving water only in the lowest basin areas.
cases.management_lesson: Topographic depressions control which pools survive as storage declines; combine elevation models with water-balance data rather than reading shoreline retreat as uniform depth loss.

provenance.title: Toshka Lakes, Southern Egypt
provenance.supports: The engineered lakes were created by diverted Lake Nasser water and lost about 80 percent of surface area between 2002 and 2012.

cases.name: Kenya Lake System (Nakuru, Bogoria, Elementaita)
cases.observed_pattern: UNESCO identifies siltation, catchment water abstraction, land degradation, deforestation and pollution as major pressures and calls for catchment-level management of groundwater, surface pollution and ecological connectivity.
cases.management_lesson: A lake diagnosis should include erosion sources, abstraction, groundwater, pollution and connectivity across the whole catchment rather than only the visible water body.

provenance.title: Kenya Lake System in the Great Rift Valley
provenance.supports: UNESCO lists siltation, increased catchment abstraction, deforestation and pollution as threats and emphasizes groundwater, surface pollution and connectivity management.

cases.name: Lake Bosumtwi
cases.observed_pattern: NASA satellite comparisons show expanding farming, settlements and mining close to the crater lake, while cited research indicates land-use change may be increasing nutrient loads and phytoplankton abundance.
cases.management_lesson: Pair shoreline and land-use change detection with water-quality indicators; catchment transformation can precede obvious loss of water surface.

provenance.title: An Explosive Beginning for Lake Bosumtwi
provenance.supports: Landsat comparisons show expansion of mining, farmland and settlements; NASA notes research linking land-use change with higher nutrient loads and phytoplankton.
